title: What Makes a Neighbourhood
goal: I can form adjectives with -beli to say where people or things are from (falubeli, helybeli).
I can talk about a housing estate (lakótelep) and a green area (zöldövezet).
I can say that a neighbourhood is safe and that neighbours help each other.
I can use four new vocabulary items related to residential zones and safety.
